product_overview: A React + Vite frontend that provides real-time chat with the Gemini AI model, plus settings management and a screen-capture workflow to send screenshots to the AI.
core_goals: Provide a responsive, streaming chat interface to interact with the Gemini AI model
Allow users to configure API keys, theme and AI behavior via a centralized Settings UI
Enable quick screen capture and include screenshots in AI conversations
Surface clear error states and guidance when features require an extension environment

features.name: Chat with AI
features.description: Real-time chat interface that sends user messages to the Gemini model and displays streaming AI responses.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type message in input field -> Click Send button -> See AI response streaming -> See final AI response appended to conversation
Navigate to / -> Type message in input field -> Click Send button -> See error notification 'Message failed to send' -> Click Retry button -> See AI response streaming
Navigate to / -> Leave input empty -> Click Send button -> See validation error 'Please enter a message'

features.name: Settings Management
features.description: Central settings panel to manage API keys, theme, and AI behavior with save and validation flows.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Settings icon -> Switch to API tab -> Click Add API key -> Fill API key field -> Click Save button -> See success notification 'Settings saved'
Navigate to / -> Click Settings icon -> Switch to API tab -> Click Add API key -> Fill API key field with invalid key -> Click Save button -> See validation error 'Invalid API key'
Navigate to / -> Click Settings icon -> Switch to General tab -> Change theme setting -> Click Save button -> See UI theme updated
Navigate to / -> Click Settings icon -> Switch to AI tab -> Modify AI behavior settings -> Click Save button -> See success notification 'Settings saved'

features.name: Screen Capture
features.description: Take a screenshot (area selection) and attach it to the chat so the AI can analyze the image.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Scissors icon -> Select area on screen -> Confirm crop -> See image preview in message composer -> Click Send button -> See AI response streaming about the image
Navigate to / -> Click Scissors icon -> Select area on screen -> Cancel crop -> See no image attached to composer
Navigate to / -> Click Scissors icon -> See error 'Screen capture unavailable in current environment' -> See instructions to install/enable extension
